recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a broader editorial cleanup of the current List.mode narrative, which would be separate from this narrow 2015 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-7393 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification for FHIR-core List, raised against DSTU1 section 6.1.4. It asked to remove "The final mode -" from the changes-list narrative and clarify that such lists can contain added, deleted, and unchanged items while preserving the rule that flags implying deletion require the deleted element.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git-svn commit 96be97f445754f44c0b4b221e698b98af635ff0d, svn revision 5595, which changed "The final mode - a changes list" to "A changes list" in source/list/list-notes.xml. A closely related FHIR-5308 commit and later QA edit revised the same paragraph's examples and wording, explaining current text differences from the original FHIR-7393 proposal.
additional_context: The List resource is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source/list/list-notes.xml no longer contains "final mode" and still says a change list may include deleted items with the deleted-flag SHALL rule. Later List deleted-flag guidance from FHIR-34442 is already represented on the combined branch and does not conflict with this clarification. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant community evidence that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The published combined-branch commit is an empty no-change audit because the current authoritative source already conveys the meaningful FHIR-7393 correction, and reverting to the exact proposed wording would be optional editorial churn rather than a necessary spec fix.

related_jiras.note: A Jan 2015 Published List ballot comment revised the same paragraph's examples immediately after FHIR-7393, explaining later wording differences from the FHIR-7393 proposal.
A later Published List decision updated deleted-flag guidance and is already represented on the combined branch; it does not require additional FHIR-7393 source changes.
